_about: The EuRoC consistency gate (#605): scripts/euroc-consistency.sh. diverge_ratio (10x OpenVINS mono's window 4-DoF ATE, the threshold #602 used) was set on 2026-11-07 before any estimator ran. The third condition was first a median yaw ANEES <= 3; review of PR #607 showed that ANEES is unsound (its error is relative to the gauge anchor but its denominator omits the anchor variance and the cross-time covariance), so it was replaced after the first results by yaw_sigma_ratio_min: the median over the matched runs of (smallest world-yaw sigma / world-yaw sigma at the anchor). The 0.5 bound lets the marginal yaw sigma fall through its correlation with observable states (the R-IEKF's runs go down to 0.52) but not collapse; the first results (MSCKF median 0.076, at most 0.127; R-IEKF median 0.90) pass or fail the same at any bound between 0.13 and 0.9. 'backends' holds each backend's recorded results (--record).
